name: DBSCAN
learningObjectives: Learn how DBSCAN identifies core, border, and noise points
Discover how DBSCAN finds arbitrarily shaped clusters
Master the eps and minPts parameters
Understand noise detection and outlier identification

controls.label: Epsilon (ε)
controls.tooltip: Maximum distance between two points to be considered neighbors. Smaller values create more clusters.

controls.label: Minimum Points
controls.tooltip: Minimum number of points required to form a dense region (core point).

controls.label: Distance Metric
controls.tooltip: Distance metric used to calculate point neighborhoods.

visualizations.title: DBSCAN Clustering
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points colored by cluster assignment with noise points marked separately

metrics.name: Number of Clusters
metrics.description: Number of clusters found by DBSCAN (determined automatically)

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measures how similar points are to their own cluster vs other clusters (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Cluster Sizes
metrics.description: Number of points assigned to each cluster

metrics.name: Noise Points
metrics.description: Number of points identified as noise/outliers

metrics.name: Noise Ratio
metrics.description: Percentage of points identified as noise

metrics.name: Core Points
metrics.description: Number of core points (points with at least minPts neighbors)
